user.title: Set up WJG XM-3820 camera
user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to your WJG camera.
{hotspot_hint}

error.cannot_connect: Camera not reachable – check IP address and Wi-Fi connection

data.motion_onvif_events: Poll camera events (channel 1, ONVIF — useless on XM-3820 and slows PTZ)
data.motion_rtsp_diff: Motion via RTSP image comparison (channel 2, continuous load)
data.motion_rtsp_interval: RTSP comparison frame interval (seconds, 1-30 — lower = faster but more load)
data.motion_rtsp_pixel_threshold: Image comparison: pixel threshold (5-100, default 30 — lower = more sensitive)
data.motion_rtsp_trigger_percent: Image comparison: trigger threshold in % (0.5-50, default 6 — lower = triggers earlier, more false alarms)
data.patrol_end: Patrol: end time (HH:MM, e.g. 06:00; same as start = always)
data.patrol_stations: Patrol: stations as clicks (level 8) from the left end stop, comma separated, in travel order — with return path e.g. 0, 4, 8, 4, 0
data.patrol_rest_station: Patrol: rest station outside the time window (number, 1 = first)
data.patrol_home_secs: Patrol: travel time to the left end stop (seconds, 5-90)

error.invalid_time: Please enter the time as HH:MM (e.g. 22:00).
error.invalid_stations: Please enter stations as numbers 0-60, comma separated (e.g. 0, 4, 8).
